chars.SALEH: SALEH: a 21-year-old Moroccan young man, short black hair, light stubble, wearing a dusty charcoal-grey work t-shirt, olive cargo work trousers with black knee pads, white tile-grout dust on his forearms
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a 20-year-old Moroccan young woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a cream oversized hoodie, light-blue wide-leg jeans, white sneakers, small gold hoop earrings
chars.HAJJA: HAJJA: a Moroccan woman in her fifties wearing a dark emerald-green satin djellaba, a beige silk headscarf, gold bracelets, thin gold-rimmed glasses

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Seen from inside the open front door of a new unfinished Moroccan villa near the sea: HAJJA sneaks up the entrance path a few steps behind GIRL, crouching slightly, eyes narrowed with suspicion, finger on her lips; GIRL walks ahead unaware, looking at her phone. Head-to-waist framing on HAJJA, her face clearly visible, mid-act. Afternoon light, calm sandy background at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Inside the villa's half-tiled living room, SALEH kneels by stacks of floor tiles and a bucket of grout, freezing mid-work and looking up toward the front window with a worried, suspicious face. Bags of cement and tools around. Head-to-waist framing, face visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. In the villa's bare entrance hall with fresh white tiles, GIRL steps in through the doorway smiling shyly at SALEH, who stands holding a tiling trowel, surprised and nervous. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, construction materials in the calm background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Wide-ish view of the empty unfinished villa salon: SALEH alone with his tools and GIRL standing close to him, both awkward and guilty, glancing toward the door. Nobody else in the house; dusty light through big windows, sea faintly visible outside. Faces visible, subjects centered.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. In the villa salon doorway HAJJA stands furious, shouting with her mouth open, pointing at GIRL with one hand and holding her phone to call someone with the other; GIRL in the foreground turns toward her mother in shock; SALEH in the background raises his hands, scared. All faces visible, subjects centered.
